note: Preview and test data only: fact lines as the beaches guide prints them (src/guides/anna-maria-island-beaches.html), labels and colons included. The link in `linked` is added here to show a value that holds one. A page that adopts the fact strip supplies its own facts.

three.label: Best for:
three.text: Couples, photographers, sunset watching, shelling, and solitude seekers.

three.label: Facilities:
three.text: None — no restrooms, no lifeguards, no shade structures. Bring everything you need.

three.label: Parking:
three.text: Limited free street parking. Arrive early on weekends.

two.label: Best for:
two.text: Guests staying in Holmes Beach rentals who want a quieter, less-crowded experience.

two.label: Parking:
two.text: Very limited street parking. Best accessed on foot or by bicycle from nearby vacation rentals.

one.label: Best for:
one.text: Visitors who want beach access combined with walkable dining and shopping.
